Caller-controlled address used for allowance spending, approval, and owner checks.

edges.reason: transfer() forwards the call to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
checkBots modifier executes before transferFrom body and can revert the transaction.
checkBots performs a low-level call against the botProtection address.
botProtection is the untrusted target of the unchecked low-level call, enabling arbitrary external code execution during transferFrom.
msg.sender selects the spender whose allowance is decremented in transferFrom.
transfer() uses msg.sender as the implicit sender.
approve() writes the allowance entry for msg.sender.
delegate() requires msg.sender == owner before executing the delegatecall.
list() requires msg.sender == owner before minting balances.
EPNS constructor sets owner = msg.sender and grants infinite allowances.
delegate() reads the owner state variable for its access-control check.
delegate() executes a delegatecall whose target and calldata are fully caller-supplied, protected only by a single owner check.
Parameter b is the raw calldata forwarded to the delegatecall.
Parameter a is the delegatecall target address, fully controlled by the caller.
list() reads owner to enforce msg.sender == owner.
list() computes balanceOf[msg.sender] = totalSupply * 6 / 100 with raw arithmetic.
list() overwrites balanceOf[address(this)], balanceOf[msg.sender] and each balanceOf[_tos[i]].
list() performs unchecked multiplication/division of totalSupply without SafeMath.
list() makes an external call to uniRouter.addLiquidityETH with msg.value.
list() builds the router deadline from block.timestamp, making execution miner-dependent.
block.timestamp + 600 is used as the Uniswap liquidity deadline.
transferFrom does balanceOf[_from] -= _value and balanceOf[_to] += _value without SafeMath.
transferFrom does allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value without SafeMath.
transferFrom executes unchecked subtraction/addition on allowances and balances.
approve() writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
EPNS constructor assigns owner = msg.sender.
EPNS constructor stores the computed pair address into uniPair.
EPNS constructor sets infinite allowances for the contract itself and for the pair.
EPNS constructor grants unlimited allowance to uniRouter.
EPNS constructor uses wETH as one side of the pair computation.
EPNS constructor calls pairFor(wETH, address(this)).
BotProtected constructor stores the supplied address into botProtection.
pairFor returns the CREATE2-derived pair address that becomes uniPair.
checkBots forwards _from into the low-level bot-protection call payload.
_numList sets balanceOf[address(this)] and both liquidity amounts in list().
_tos provides the recipients whose balances are overwritten in list().
_amounts provides the balances assigned to each recipient in list().
The EPNS constructor forwards _botProtection to the BotProtected constructor.
transfer forwards its _to parameter into transferFrom.
transfer forwards its _value parameter into transferFrom.
_from is the debited sender inside transferFrom.
_to is the credited recipient inside transferFrom.
_value is the transferred amount used in the unchecked arithmetic.
_spender is the approval target in approve.
_value is the approved amount in approve.
tokenA participates in the pair address hashing.
tokenB participates in the pair address hashing.
The pair local variable holds the pairFor return value.
